definitions.de: Bewachen, beobachten oder hüten; jemanden oder etwas im Auge behalten, oft zum Schutz
definitions.en: To watch over, guard, or keep an eye on someone or something; to stand watch or keep vigil
definitions.es: Vigilar, cuidar o guardar; mantener un ojo en alguien o algo, a menudo para protegerlo
definitions.fr: Surveiller, garder ou veiller sur; garder un œil sur quelqu'un ou quelque chose, souvent pour le protéger
definitions.hi: किसी की देखभाल करना, पहरा देना या निगरानी रखना; किसी की रखवाली करना
definitions.ja: 見張る、守る、または目を離さずにいる；番をしたり見守ったりする
definitions.km: ប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន ការពារ ឬសំឡឹងមើល; ប្រុងមើលនរណាម្នាក់ ឬអ្វីមួយ ជាញឹកញាប់ដើម្បីការពារ
definitions.ko: 지키다, 감시하다, 또는 주시하다; 누군가나 무언가를 보호하기 위해 감시하거나 경계하다
definitions.ne: हेर्नु, पहरा दिनु वा ध्यान राख्नु; कसैलाई वा केहीलाई प्राय: सुरक्षाका लागि हेर्नु
definitions.pt: Vigiar, guardar ou tomar conta; ficar de olho em alguém ou algo, muitas vezes para proteger
definitions.th: เฝ้าดู คุ้มกัน หรือระวังรักษา; คอยดูแลหรือเฝ้าระวังใครบางคนหรือสิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่ง
definitions.tl: Bantayan, ingatan, o alagaan; subaybayan ang isang tao o bagay, kadalasan para sa proteksyon
definitions.ur: نگرانی کرنا، پہرہ دینا یا دیکھ بھال کرنا؛ کسی کی یا کسی چیز کی حفاظت کے لیے نظر رکھنا
definitions.vi: Canh gác, trông chừng, hoặc theo dõi; đứng gác hoặc trông coi ai đó hay thứ gì đó
definitions.zh: 看守、守护或监视；照看或看护某人或某物，通常是为了保护
definitions.zh_Hant: 看守、守護或監視；照看或看護某人或某物，通常是為了保護

definition_en: To watch over, guard, or keep an eye on someone or something; to stand watch or keep vigil

lao_examples.romanization: suai fao dek noi wai kon dai bo
lao_examples.translation_en: Can you watch the little kid for a moment?

lao_examples.romanization: tong fao huan wai, ya hai khon khao
lao_examples.translation_en: You have to guard the house, don't let anyone come in.
